content:
Using integral comparison for \(f(x)=1/\sqrt{x}\):

\[
\int_1^{2025} \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}} < \sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{\sqrt{i}} < 1+\int_1^{2024}\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}}
\]

Compute:

\[
\int_1^{2025} \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}} = 2\sqrt{2025}-2 = 88
\]

and

\[
1+\int_1^{2024}\frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}} = 1+(2\sqrt{2024}-2)=2\sqrt{2024}-1<2\cdot 45-1=89.
\]

Thus

\[
88 < \sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{\sqrt{i}} < 89.
\]

Therefore, the largest integer not exceeding the sum is

\[
\boxed{88}
\]
